question: In Non-Small Cell Lung combination therapy trials, normalize the combination type to standardized labels (e.g., ICI+Chemo, ICI+TKI, ICI+ICI).

steps.desc: Filter NSCLC combination trials and select combination type.
Map free text to controlled combination categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Type of combination and emit JSON {NCT, PMID, combination_type} with label in ["ICI+Chemo","ICI+TKI","ICI+ICI","OTHER/UNKNOWN"]. Heuristics: if chemotherapy mentioned, then ICI+Chemo; if TKI mentioned, then ICI+TKI; if multiple ICIs mentioned, then ICI+ICI; otherwise OTHER/UNKNOWN. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
